title: Most HQ screens are never opened by an automated test
what: Only the payments list and the web page switch are driven in a browser. Leads, Delete requests, Log, the menu, the Needs you words, alerts and the install button are checked only through helpers or the server, or not at all. 13 of 43 journeys have no test.
expected: Each HQ screen people use has a browser test that checks its words and its refusals.
fix_line: Add one browser test per HQ screen with a fake server, like the payments one

title: The gym delete test never tries pictures that cannot be removed
what: The only test of picture removal has every picture removed. The case where some stay, with its message and its log line, is never run.
expected: A test where storage refuses a picture checks the "pictures are left" words and the log line.
fix_line: Add a test where storage refuses one picture

title: The "nothing left" check after a gym delete looks at only two tables
what: HQ tells the admin it checked every table and nothing is left. The database test only counts the gym row and the main records table; the server test feeds in a made-up table count.
expected: The test checks every table with a gym column is empty for the deleted gym.
fix_line: Loop over every table with a gym column in the database test
